trap.label: remember + -ing
trap.wrong: He remembers to work in a bakery when he was young.
trap.right: He remembers working in a bakery when he was young.
trap.why: Em português “lembra de trabalhar” serve para os dois sentidos. Em inglês, lembrar de um fato passado pede remember + -ing; remember to + base é lembrar de fazer algo.

mcq.q: He remembers ___ in a bakery as a teen. (memória)

mcq.why: Despite + substantivo, sem “of”. Although exige oração.

mcq.q: She is ___ to become a director.
He graduated; ___, he got a job at a firm.

fix.wrong: Despite of the cost, he studied.
I remember to visit the site last year.
fix.right: I remember visiting the site last year.

fix.wrong: He is probably to win the prize.
fix.right: He is likely to win the prize.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Despite: “Although the funds were limited, she studied.”
rewrite.answer: Despite the limited funds, she studied.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com “likely”: “She will probably join the firm.”
rewrite.answer: She is likely to join the firm.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com remember + -ing: “I recall that I visited the site.”
